mapper.sql: select id, order_no, product_type, status, attempts, next_retry_time, locked_at, completed_time, last_error, created_time, updated_time from osh_order_entitlement_task
mapper.select: where (status = 0 and next_retry_time <= #{now}) or (status = 1 and locked_at <= #{staleBefore}) order by next_retry_time asc, id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update osh_order_entitlement_task set status = 1, attempts = attempts + 1, locked_at = #{now}, updated_time = #{now} where order_no = #{orderNo} and ((status = 0 and next_retry_time <= #{now}) or (status = 1 and locked_at <= #{staleBefore}))
update osh_order_entitlement_task set status = 2, completed_time = #{completedTime}, locked_at = null, last_error = null, updated_time = #{completedTime} where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 1

update osh_order_entitlement_task set status = 0, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, locked_at = null, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where order_no = #{orderNo} and status = 1
